fato_historico: 1999: Maurice Papon, an official in the Vichy government during World War II, is jailed for crimes against humanity.
energia_do_dia: The cosmic tides suggest a time of profound emotional clearing. Just as history reminds us that justice eventually surfaces to heal deep wounds, you may find it is a good time to release past burdens. Consider embracing your sensitivity as a superpower, allowing yourself to flow gracefully through the day while finding closure where it is needed most.
frase_do_dia: The shadows of the past yield to the light of your tender heart.
significado_numero: Represents the master builder energy for creating lasting emotional stability.
conselho: Trust your intuition and let go of what no longer serves your spirit today.
